Fleetclear.main_product: Connected fleet management software, tracking, telematics, and vehicle safety hardware solutions.
Fleetclear.reason: Fleetclear provides an integrated end-to-end connected-fleet platform (Fleetclear Connect) combining vehicle tracking, telematics, digital video recording, and fleet management software built natively on their vehicle data.

Fleet Software Solutions Ltd.main_product: Vehicle telematics and asset tracking platform
Fleet Software Solutions Ltd.reason: The company's primary business and main product offerings center directly around hardware-agnostic vehicle tracking, vehicle telematics, integrated camera solutions, and GPS asset tracking platforms.

Franstrack Ltd.reason: Franstrack's main product offering is an enterprise-grade fleet management and telematics platform that provides real-time GPS vehicle tracking, trip history, speed alerts, and asset monitoring across multiple pricing tiers.

Advanced Telematics Ltd.main_product: vehicle telematics and fleet tracking software
Advanced Telematics Ltd.reason: Advanced Telematics Ltd focuses exclusively on providing GPS vehicle tracking, video telematics, and fleet management software platforms along with nationwide device installation services in the UK.
